title: Contract Deployer
description: Deploy smart contracts deterministically using CREATE2 proxy
feature_2: Same contract address on every network

faqs.create2_explanation: CREATE2 is an Ethereum opcode that allows deterministic contract deployment. It calculates the contract address before deployment based on bytecode and salt, ensuring the same address across different networks.
faqs.deterministic_explanation: Deterministic deployment means the contract will always be deployed to the same address on any network, as long as you use the same bytecode, constructor arguments, and salt. This is extremely useful for cross-chain applications.
faqs.bytecode_explanation: Bytecode is the compiled version of your smart contract code. When you compile your Solidity contract, you get bytecode which is the actual code that runs on the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM).
faqs.abi_explanation: ABI (Application Binary Interface) defines how to interact with your contract. For deployment, you need the constructor ABI to properly encode the constructor arguments. You can provide it in JSON format or human-readable format.
faqs.salt_explanation: Salt is a 32-byte value used in CREATE2 to generate the contract address. Different salts result in different addresses. You can use the same salt to deploy to the same address on different networks.

seo.howto_name: How to Deploy Contracts Deterministically with CREATE2
seo.howto_description: Step-by-step guide to deploy smart contracts to the same address across multiple networks using CREATE2 proxy.
seo.step_1_text: Connect your Web3 wallet to the network where you want to deploy the contract. Make sure you have enough native tokens for gas fees.
seo.step_2_text: Verify that the CREATE2 proxy contract is available on your selected network. The system will check if the proxy exists at the standard address.
seo.step_3_text: Enter your contract bytecode, constructor ABI, constructor arguments, and salt. The system will calculate and show the predicted contract address. Click deploy to execute the deployment transaction.
